result_text:
The "Undefined Team" now only collects active contributors. I compiled the `codeanalyzer` module and it built cleanly. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't look for existing tests of this method or add one.

The change is one condition in `getAllTeams()` in `codeanalyzer/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/sourcecode/landscape/analysis/LandscapeAnalysisResults.java`. A contributor matched by no team is added to the remainder only if `contributor.getContributor().isActive()` is true.

- **Dormant contributors:** an unmatched contributor with a latest commit older than the 180-day threshold is now left out of the remainder.
- **Blank dates:** a blank latest-commit date already counts as active in `DateUtils.isDateWithinRange`, so those contributors stay in.
- **Configured teams:** the team-matching code is untouched, so those teams keep all their members, active or not.

`isActive()` measures the 180 days back from the current date (`DateUtils.getCalendar()`), not from a separate analysis date. I didn't check whether `getCalendar()` can be set to a fixed analysis date.
